```{r packages}
if(!require("BiocManager", quietly = T))
  install.packages("BiocManager")

# Install the necessary bioinformatics packages
# TCGAbiolinks: for data access
# GSVA: for the 94-gene signature scoring
# SummarizedExperiment: the standard data container for TCGA data
BiocManager::install(c("TCGAbiolinks", "GSVA", "SummarizedExperiment"))

install.packages("nloptr")
install.packages("ggpubr")
install.packages("cowplot")
install.packages("gt")
```


```{r load packages}
library(BiocManager)
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(GSVA)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(tidyverse)
library(nloptr)
library(ggpubr)
library(cowplot)
library(gt)
library(webshot2)
```

# Check which methylation data are available for candidate cancer types
```{r}

candidates <- c("TCGA-HNSC", "TCGA-STAD", "TCGA-KIRC", "TCGA-BLCA", 
                "TCGA-KIRP", "TCGA-BRCA", "TCGA-COAD")

# Query methylation data availability for one cancer first
query_met <- GDCquery(
  project = "TCGA-HNSC",
  data.category = "DNA Methylation",
  data.type = "Methylation Beta Value",
  platform = "Illumina Human Methylation 450"
)

getResults(query_met) %>% 
  count(sample_type)

#           sample_type   n
# 1          Metastatic   2
# 2       Primary Tumor 528
# 3 Solid Tissue Normal  50


```

# Check clinical data availability
```{r}

# Get clnicial data
clinical_hnsc <- GDCquery_clinic("TCGA-HNSC", type = "clinical")

clinical_hnsc <- GDCquery_clinic("TCGA-HNSC", type = "BCR XML")

query_clin <- GDCquery(
  project = "TCGA-HNSC",
  data.category = "Clinical",
  data.type = "Clinical Supplement",
  data.format = "BCR XML"
)

GDCdownload(query_clin)
clinical_hnsc <- GDCprepare_clinic(query_clin, clinical.info = "patient")

# What outcome variables are available?
colnames(clinical_hnsc)

# Check for specific survival columns 
clinical_hnsc %>% 
  select(any_of(c("vital_status", 
                  "days_to_death",
                  "days_to_last_followup",
                  "tumor_stage",
                  "ajcc_pathologic_stage"))) %>% 
  View()

clinical_hnsc %>% 
  select(vital_status, 
         days_to_death,
         days_to_last_followup,
         stage_event_pathologic_stage) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_vital_status = sum(!is.na(vital_status)),
    n_days_to_death = sum(!is.na(days_to_death)),
    n_days_to_last_followup = sum(!is.na(days_to_last_followup))
  )

  # n_total n_vital_status n_days_to_death n_days_to_last_followup
  #    528            160             170                     314

# The number of patients with vital_status is only 160 ~30%
# need to define who is dead vs who is censored

# Check how many patients have either days_to_death OR days_to_last_followup but are missing vital_status
clinical_hnsc %>%
  count(vital_status, is.na(days_to_death))


```

# Data Availability table across all candidate cancer types 
Checking for methylation, RNA-seq (GSEA, IFN signature score analsyes), DNA-seq (for immunotherapy-related biomarker correlations), and survival data
```{r}
check_data_availability <- function(project_id) {
  
  message("Checking: ", project_id)
  
  # Methylation
  met <- tryCatch({
    q <- GDCquery(project = project_id,
                  data.category = "DNA Methylation",
                  data.type = "Methylation Beta Value",
                  platform = "Illumina Human Methylation 450")
    res <- getResults(q)
    tibble(
      n_met_tumor = sum(res$sample_type == "Primary Tumor"),
      n_met_normal = sum(res$sample_type == "Solid Tissue Normal")
    )
  }, error = function(e) tibble(n_met_tumor = NA, n_met_normal = NA))
  
  # RNA-seq
  rna <- tryCatch({
    q <- GDCquery(project = project_id,
                  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
                  data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
                  workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
                  sample.type = c("Primary Tumor", "Solid Tissue Normal"))
    res <- getResults(q)
    tibble(
      n_rna_tumor = sum(res$sample_type == "Primary Tumor"),
      n_rna_normal = sum(res$sample_type == "Solid Tissue Normal")
    )
  }, error = function(e) tibble(n_rna_tumor = NA, n_rna_normal = NA))
  
  # DNA-seq (WXS for somatic mutations/TMB/KRAS)
  dna <- tryCatch({
  q <- GDCquery(project = project_id,
                data.category = "Simple Nucleotide Variation",
                data.type = "Masked Somatic Mutation")
  res <- getResults(q)
  tibble(n_dna_tumor = nrow(res))
}, error = function(e) tibble(n_dna_tumor = NA))
  # Clinical
  clin <- tryCatch({
    q <- GDCquery(project = project_id,
                  data.category = "Clinical",
                  data.type = "Clinical Supplement",
                  data.format = "BCR XML")
    res <- getResults(q)
    tibble(n_clinical = nrow(res))
  }, error = function(e) tibble(n_clinical = NA))
  
  bind_cols(tibble(project = project_id), met, rna, dna, clin)
}

# Run across candidates
candidates <- c("TCGA-HNSC", "TCGA-STAD", "TCGA-KIRC", 
                "TCGA-BLCA", "TCGA-KIRP", "TCGA-BRCA", "TCGA-COAD")

availability_table <- map_dfr(candidates, check_data_availability)

print(availability_table)
```

## make table
```{r}

availability_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "TCGA Data Availability for Candidate Cancer Types"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    project = "Cancer Type",
    n_met_tumor = "Tumor",
    n_met_normal = "Normal",
    n_rna_tumor = "Tumor",
    n_rna_normal = "Normal",
    n_dna_tumor = "Tumor",
    n_clinical = "Cases"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Methylation", columns = c(n_met_tumor, n_met_normal)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "RNA-seq", columns = c(n_rna_tumor, n_rna_normal)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "DNA-seq", columns = n_dna_tumor) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Clinical", columns = n_clinical) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = seq(1, nrow(availability_table), 2))
  ) %>%
  opt_table_font(font = "Arial")
```
